title: Outward commentary / tafsir vs Inner interpretation / ta'wil
content_summary: Two-column comparison of tafsir and ta'wil across question, method, example, authority, audience, and end state.
text_blocks: Outward commentary / tafsir
Question: What does this word mean in plain Arabic?
Method: Dictionary, grammar, ordinary sense.
Example ('Tree'): A plant set down small, growing limbs, leaves, flowers, fruit.
Authority: Any competent reader of the language.
Audience: The common public.
End State: The verse is intelligible at the surface.
Inner interpretation / ta'wil
Question: What truth was this verse sent to carry?
Method: A chain back to the moment meaning was placed inside the word.
Example ('Tree'): A chamber, cow, or rock—whatever the inner reality is, provided it accords with truth and reason.
Authority: The Imam, in a chain from the Speaker-Prophet.
Audience: The elect, by stages.
End State: The meaning hidden behind the word is reached.
Neither denies the other. The outer holds the inner the way a body holds its soul. Both are obligatory; benefit arises only from their meeting.

title: The Pedagogy of Disclosure Requires Binding Stages
content_summary: Three-stage flow from newly born believer through Outward Repair, Symbols and Signs, and Inner Interpretation Proper to the responder in the mission, with refusal branches.
text_blocks: THE PEDAGOGY OF DISCLOSURE REQUIRES BINDING STAGES
The one newly born in faith.
1. OUTWARD REPAIR
Content: Limits, allegiance, lawful/forbidden.
Mode: Obligation. Likeness: Cutting the cord, swaddling.
Refusal to advance. The worshipper's testimony is honored, but the next room is closed.
2. SYMBOLS AND SIGNS
Content: Gentle inner degree, imagination stirred.
Mode: Preparation. Likeness: Milk for the newborn.
Refusal to advance. Locked at the current rung.
3. INNER INTERPRETATION PROPER
Content: Ta'wil beyond symbols. Mode: Choice and pledge. Likeness: Solid food for a ready body.
The responder enters the ranks of the mission.

title: A Single Utterance Carries Graded Meanings
content_summary: Concentric circles diagram with callouts naming the Utterance and successive faces of meaning.
text_blocks: A SINGLE UTTERANCE CARRIES GRADED MEANINGS
The Utterance: A single finite revealed word.
The First Face: What the beginner hears.
Seventy Faces and Beyond. Accessible only to those who have reached the highest stations. The word is finite; what it contains is not.
Subsequent Faces: Visible only as the listener climbs.
The Second Face: Heard only by one further along.

title: Physical Divergence Carries a Unified Inner Obligation
content_summary: Two-column comparison contrasting distinct outward forms with their shared inward content as the Comprehensive Container.
text_blocks: PHYSICAL DIVERGENCE CARRIES A UNIFIED INNER OBLIGATION
THEIR OUTWARD FORMS
THEIR INWARD CONTENT
The Ark ≠ The Sacred House
The Sacred House ≠ The Staff
The Staff ≠ The Cross
The Cross ≠ The Testimony
Each is a different physical thing.
Believing in the foundation is accepting the entire law.
The act of pledge already gathers what the law requires.
If partial, the call would be incomplete.
The Comprehensive Container
The pledge of allegiance carries the totality, not the easier piece first. Where allegiance is concerned, the whole obligation is laid out at the moment of the call.

title: Breaking the Testimony Halves the Architecture
content_summary: Table contrasting the Philosophers and the People of Outward Islam by what they recognized, denied, and what broke.
text_blocks: BREAKING THE TESTIMONY HALVES THE ARCHITECTURE
GROUP
WHAT THEY RECOGNIZED
WHAT THEY DENIED
WHAT BROKE
The Philosophers
The upper spiritual limits (renamed intellect and soul).
The lower earthly limits (no messengers in their system).
The testimony lacks its earthly correspondent.
The People of Outward Islam
The lower earthly limits (prophet and law).
The inner office of the Silent One.

Each affirmed some and denied others. The testimony is whole only when all four limits are held together.

title: Fire-Knowledge and Clay-Knowledge Are Both Given Gifts
content_summary: Two-column comparison of Iblis (fire-knowledge) and Adam (clay-knowledge) across type, mode, acquisition, self-image, and end state.
text_blocks: FIRE-KNOWLEDGE AND CLAY-KNOWLEDGE ARE BOTH GIVEN GIFTS
IBLIS / FIRE-KNOWLEDGE
TYPE: Gentle, spiritual, luminous, untethered.
MODE: Brilliant supportive knowledge carrying no body.
ACQUISITION: By nature, from the upper substance.
SELF-IMAGE: Better than Adam, refusing the rank of follower.
END STATE: Arrogance built on possession of the subtle.
ADAM / CLAY-KNOWLEDGE
TYPE: Dense, corporeal, argumentative, embodied.
MODE: Knowledge bound to matter.
ACQUISITION: Taught by stages, starting with the apparent.
SELF-IMAGE: Humbled, learns the names from God.
END STATE: Receives obedience because of what was breathed into him.
Both kinds of knowledge are gifts. Forgetting this is the structure of every pride built from knowledge.

title: The Forbidden Tree Is the Shape of Premature Timing
content_summary: Octagon-and-square emblem with callouts for Manifest Unveiling and The Seal, plus three bullet points on premature claim and timing error.
text_blocks: THE FORBIDDEN TREE IS THE SHAPE OF PREMATURE TIMING
THE SEAL
Hides the ultimate disclosure until the appointed Day.
MANIFEST UNVEILING
The knowledge of the Prophet's family, preserved for them, authorized to no other.
The general claim fixes on the outer (wheat, fig, grape) and loses the inner.
The actual "Tree" is the rank reserved for the Master of the Resurrection (The Awaited Riser).
Adam's transgression was reaching for a rank not his to occupy. It was an error of timing, not an appetite for fruit.

title: Stumbling Is Not Turning Aside
content_summary: Flow from Adam and Eve in the Garden through the adversary's lie to a split between Iblis's persistence and Adam's repentance and restoration.
text_blocks: STUMBLING IS NOT TURNING ASIDE
Adam and Eve in the Garden (ranks of supportive knowledge)
Adversary's lie (Premature disclosure dressed as transcendence)
Transgression (Reaching for the rank of the Riser)
Garment of piety cut off. Light of wisdom stitched to cover shame
Iblis turns aside. Refuses repentance. Persists. Crosses over to the opposing party.
Adam turns back. Asks forgiveness through the guardian of his time (Eve).
Repentance accepted. Adam restored to the line of Imamate. The cycle continues.

title: Standing Still on the Road of Forgetfulness Is Still Walking
content_summary: Two-column comparison of the Party of Allah / Adam's Path and the Party of Satan / Iblis's Path across allegiance, orientation, behavior, end state, and the daily test.
text_blocks: STANDING STILL ON THE ROAD OF FORGETFULNESS IS STILL WALKING
PARTY OF ALLAH / ADAM'S PATH
Allegiance: To God and His guardians.
Orientation: Heart turned toward the guardian of the time.
Behavior: Does not love those who oppose the architecture.
End State: Eternal abode.
The Daily Test: A stumbler who returns and repents belongs here.
PARTY OF SATAN / IBLIS'S PATH
Allegiance: To the adversary and his lieutenants.
Orientation: Heart turned away, toward forgetfulness.
Behavior: Uses oaths as cover, averts people from the way.
End State: Companions of the Fire.
The Daily Test: One who persists in sin and refuses repentance belongs here.
The worshipper does not walk between the two roads. The verdict is not pronounced once, but renewed in every moment, because the heart's orientation is renewed in every moment.
